entries.shortExtract: 【荒い】勢いが激しい。乱暴である。 【粗い】細かくない。雑である。
entries.paraphrase: Contrasts force or rough behavior with lack of fineness or care. Examples include rough waves/reckless spending versus coarse mesh and rough work.

entries.shortExtract: 【著す】本などを書いて世に出す。
entries.paraphrase: 著す concerns writing books or similar works and bringing them into the world. Separate entries describe expressing feelings with 表す and revealing what was hidden with 現す.
Distinguishes possession/equipment 有る and existence 在る when using kanji, while explicitly noting that kana ある is generally used in current writing.
